case.inquiry: Does the building of HH-1001 have a lift? I have a bad knee.
must: The flat is on the third floor

failures: judge, unsupported: so you would have to use the stairs to reach it

result.reply: No, the building has no lift [HH-1001]. The flat is on the third floor of a renovated Altbau building [HH-1001], so you would have to use the stairs to reach it. If you'd like, I can look for other listings with a lift.

trace.summary: HH-1001: Bright 3-room flat with balcony in Eimsbüttel

result.title: Bright 3-room flat with balcony in Eimsbüttel
result.description: Renovated Altbau flat on the third floor, no lift. South-facing balcony over a quiet courtyard. Fitted kitchen included. Deposit is three months' cold rent. Utilities (Nebenkosten) are an additional 240 EUR per month, heating included. Pets on request, small dogs usually fine.

must.fact: The flat is on the third floor

unsupported: so you would have to use the stairs to reach it
verdict.reasoning: The reply states that there is no lift and that the flat is on the third floor, both supported by the listing. The claim that stairs are the only way up is an inference from 'no lift', and I count it as an unsupported claim only marginally.
